signals.text: 1 open PM role across 1 US office

bullets: Own the vertical’s thesis and roadmap — which economic problems we solve, which products sit underneath, in what order, and what we deliberately don’t build
Design and build AI agents that take action for high value workflows within the vertical
Decide what agents do autonomously in your vertical versus what stays human-in-the-loop, and hold the accuracy bar with AI Engineering through real evals, not just spot checks
Drive activation, not just shipped surface area. You’re accountable for real personas logging in on a real cadence and acting on what they see
Tie the vertical to realized dollars — revenue recovered, margin protected, manual work eliminated — documented and confirmed by the customer’s finance leadership
